assets.generationPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: full-frame snow material plate for an animated reveal, landscape 16:9. Primary request: natural fresh fine-grained white snow viewed at close range from a gently oblique overhead camera. Broad softly rounded irregular low drifts, very subtle wind-shaped microtexture and soft blue-grey shadows, diffuse overcast lighting. Fill the entire image with snow, no sky or horizon, no foreground objects, no footprints, no people, no trees, no text, no border. Avoid regular repeating bands, ornamental patterns, glossy plastic and exaggerated ridges. The material should be quiet and smooth at screen scale yet convincingly granular when seen closely.
assets.method: Built-in image generation; RGB raster material animated through the shared feathered contour mask.
assets.rationale: Natural fine grains preserve the snow material identity without regular repeated bands; editable contour and feather control its motion edge.

assets.generationPrompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: transparent cutout sprite sheet for a documentary motion collage. Four distinct anonymous adult soldiers in unmarked mid-20th-century olive-drab field uniforms and round steel helmets, each crouching or kneeling and aiming a long rifle horizontally toward the LEFT. Full figure and entire rifle visible in each cell, neutral side/three-quarter view, realistic photographic texture, dark cinematic muted tones with a subtle warm rim. Arrange EXACTLY four isolated figures in a 2 by 2 grid of equally sized cells on a genuinely transparent background. Each figure and its rifle must fit fully within its own cell, with wide clear transparent gutters and no overlap between cells. No terrain, no smoke, no muzzle flash, no flags or insignia, no text, no borders, no visible wounds. Different kneeling poses but rifles all aim left. Each figure will be independently cropped from its quadrant and animated.
assets.method: generated RGBA sheet; each quadrant is cropped at runtime; per-soldier transforms, recoil and muzzle anchor
assets.rationale: Independent anonymous figures allow staggered visual firing and depth placement without asserting real identities or historical events.

assets.generationPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent VFX fireball texture for documentary animation. One large billowing orange and golden-yellow explosion fireball, near-white incandescent core and intensely detailed turbulent orange lobes, darker red curling edges, some dark smoke mixing at the top. Broad round irregular mushroom-like mass, entire fireball contained inside the frame with transparent padding all around. Photorealistic cinematic VFX, isolated on genuinely transparent background. No ground, no people, no buildings, no weapons, no lettering, no sparks trails extending to frame edges. This is a compositing texture; avoid a square or opaque backdrop.
assets.method: generated RGBA VFX plate with independent expansion, pulsation and turbulence layers
assets.rationale: A broad billowing blast is visually distinct from the earlier room flames. Expansion behind the ridge builds escalation.

assets.generationPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent rocky foreground cutout for a cinematic documentary collage. A broad dark rough rocky ridge with several irregular peaks and small ledges, like a low rocky outcrop rising from the lower frame, wet black-brown rock with fine realistic mineral detail. The highest central peak at about half the image height; lower left and right shoulders. Side/front camera view, full ridge spans nearly the image width but with padding, entirely isolated on genuinely transparent background. Muted diffuse overcast lighting, no people, no vegetation, no sky, no fire, no text. Keep the bottom edge a continuous thick rock mass so it can extend below the video frame.
assets.method: generated RGBA rocky cutout; foreground occlusion pass
assets.rationale: A separate rock cutout provides a shared ground plane and occludes the lower legs to anchor the collage.

assets.generationPrompt: Create a new cinematic 16:9 background plate using the supplied reference ONLY for lighting, perspective and atmosphere. An empty 1930s–1940s industrial military warehouse / underground supply depot interior. Deep central aisle, receding ceiling beams and metal pipes, rows of hanging round warm tungsten lamps becoming small golden bokeh in the distance, dark shelves and shadowy machinery at far sides, amber haze illuminated from the upper left, realistic warm brown/olive tones, filmic high contrast, believable detailed photography. Camera at chest height looking horizontally down the aisle, central vanishing point around x52% y48%. Empty foreground, no people, no foreground crates or bags, no flags, no symbols, no writing, no watermark, no UI, no arrows. This clean plate will be layered behind independently animated cutouts.
assets.rationale: Match the supplied warm historical collage while keeping parallax layers editable.

Seen from straight ahead slightly above, full object isolated with margin on all sides, natural 4:3 aspect.
